title: Convent Chronicles: Revelation
description:
Where faith is everything - when evil comes for you, you had better say your prayers.

In Convent Chronicles: Revelation follow the story of Sister Mary Angelica and the Sisters of Saint Dymphna, as the world opens anew thanks to sweeping changes from the neo-reformation. However, Angelica finds the world outside the convent walls is not the Edenford she remembers.

Before she knows it, Angelica finds herself thrust into a centuries old conflict, where sinister forces work to undermine the faith of the people and bring forth the complete destruction of Saint Dymphna's Convent.

With her sisters by her side, the intrepid young nun faces the forces of evil while holding those most important to her closest to her heart. As her world shatters, she prays to hold on to every shard she has left.

Features:

• Over 3,000 unique full-screen images, bringing the visuals of the story truly to life.

• 17 chapters, each with alternate scenes based on player choice.

• Over 200 unlockable CGs

• Over 100 unique musical compositions

This product contains scenes of violence, blood, partial nudity, sexual situations, death, and other topics that may be considered disturbing and is intended for mature audiences.
description_short: When evil surrounds the convent Sister Mary Angelica must face a frightening and changing world. With friends and Mother Superior, she learns of the mysterious history and the secrets the sisters hold to drive back the darkness. Tests of faith, willpower and love abound in this vibrant visual novel.
